name: Voronoi-like Segmentation Volume Generation
definition: Generates a Voronoi-like segmentation volume by creating a Poisson-like point set and assigning each voxel the label of its nearest neighbor in that point set.
summary: Voronoi-like Segmentation Volume Generation creates hard, discrete spatial partitions by assigning each voxel to its nearest Poisson-distributed seed point, differing from soft methods by producing non-differentiable boundaries suitable for texture synthesis.
